neighbours.label: the piece after N or NH in a letter string N + h (N|ha, N|hat, N|hu, N|HA, N|HT|SA, NH|RA), as opposed to N + another letter (N|inh, N|ga, N|PA, N|TS|B) and whole tokens (' NHS')
fire: The writer Nhat Hanh taught in France.
The family of Nham lives near the river.
Her cousin Nhan runs a shop in Hue.
The NHTSA issued a report on the cars.
The NHRA drag races are held in Ohio.
The port of Nhava is near Mumbai.
The leader Ngo Dinh Nhu was killed in 1963.
The Housing Agency of the nation (NHA) built the flats.
quiet: The writer Nguyen taught in France.
The family of Ninh lives near the river.
Her cousin Nga runs a shop in Hue.
The NTSB issued a report on the cars.
The NHS runs the clinics in Ohio.
The port of Nantes is near the coast.
The leader Ngo Dinh Diem was killed in 1963.

short: piece after N in an N+h letter string
notes: Gate-closed regime dominates on the other pole. Card: 'ار' x10, 'AN' x3, 'hs' x3, 'HS' x3, ' Nh' x2, 'HA' x2. Probes: NH|AN 1.05, N|ha 0.90, N|HA 0.80, Nh|e 0.27, ' Nhi' 0.25; ' NHS' as a whole token 0.07; N|PA, Hanoi, census 0.00, (HS) without N 0.002. 'ار' on the card did not reproduce (0.004), so about a third of the top examples are not covered. Pieces checked with the tokenizer.
